description: This file defines the UpdateSmsCampaignCommandHandler class, which handles update commands for SMS campaigns within the campaign infrastructure. It processes commands by invoking the update method on SmsCampaignWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateSmsCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler for processing update commands for SMS campaigns, utilizing dependency injection for the service and processing commands transactionally.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JsonCommand to update the SMS campaign using the write platform service.
